messages.subject: Re: Mediation analysis controlling for 2 covariates
parts:
Does this look right?

That is what you syntax is doing.  But for your a and b (and c) paths to have the same interpretation (i.e., "controlling for ..."), you should also regress the mediator on the same covariates.

is it right that i’m using each individual item from the ocd and mdd scales as indicators? And if i’m doing that, should I be using the individual items for t1 and t2 mdd as covariates rather than item with the total?

You don't necessarily need to use multiple indicators for the covariate.  There are good arguments for accounting for their measurement error, but if you have a modest sample size and want to avoid a huge model, you could fix the residual variances of single-indicator covariates to correspond with 1 - reliability, so the latent component is just (estimated) reliable variance.
